wikipedia.title: Alibag
wikipedia.text:
Alibag (pronounced [əlibaːɡ]), also known as Alibaug, is a coastal city and a municipal council in the Raigad district of Maharashtra, India. It is the headquarters of the Raigad district, and is south of the city of Mumbai. Alibag is part of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region and is situated at a distance of about 96 kilometres (60 mi) from Mumbai and 143 kilometres (89 mi) from Pune. 
Alibag is a holy place for Padmakshi Renuka, who is also known as the goddess of Konkan.

wikipedia.title: Raigad district
wikipedia.text:
Raigad district (Marathi pronunciation: [ɾaːjɡəɖ]), previously Colaba district, is a district in the Konkan division of Maharashtra, India.
The headquarters of the district is Alibag. Raigad district is located in the western part of Maharashtra. Other major cities in the district are Panvel, Karjat, Navi Mumbai, Khopoli, Shrivardhan and Mahad.

wikipedia.title: Colaba Observatory
wikipedia.text: Colaba Observatory, also known as the Bombay Observatory, was an astronomical, timekeeping, geomagnetic and meteorological observatory located on the Island of Colaba, Mumbai (Bombay), India.

wikipedia.title: Alibag Assembly constituency
wikipedia.text: Alibag Assembly constituency is one of the 288 Vidhan Sabha (Assembly) constituencies of Maharashtra state in Western India. It comes inside Raigad district of Konkan division.

wikipedia.title: Alibag taluka
wikipedia.text: Alibag taluka is a subdistrict/upazila/tehsil in Raigad district of the Indian state of Maharashtra.

wikivoyage.title: Alibag
wikivoyage.text:
Alibag (also spelt Alibaug) is the headquarters of the Raigad district of Maharashtra. It's best known for its historic marine forts, fine beaches and clean water.


== See and do ==


=== Forts ===
1 Kolaba Fort. A fort about 1km from the shore into the sea, reachable by foot at low tide (but not during the monsoon season). You can go on the island and roam around for free, but the entrance to the fort is by ticket only. ₹100 for foreign tourists. (updated Jun 2023)
2 Revdanda Fort. A historical monument built on the Revdanda beach. Ideal place for pre-wedding shoots. The main entrance is from the southern side. (updated Jun 2023)


=== Beaches ===
3 Kihim Beach. A beautiful coastal village and a weekend getaway for Mumbaikars. The climate of Kihim is very calm and unpolluted. There is parasailing on Kihim Beach but it is seasonal. (updated Jun 2023)
4 Mandwa Beach. A beach popularised by a Bollywood series. It has direct ferry services to and from Mumbai. (updated Jun 2023)
 Varsoli Beach.  


== Eat and drink ==
Alibag has lots of restaurants and bars, and soft drinks and liquor are freely available.

Sanman restaurant, specialises in sea food. They have different thalis with different fishes like Pomfret, Surmai etc. Each thali will have one fried piece and one curry piece of fish. The rest of the items are also a speciality of that area like bhakri (chapati) of rice powder, solkadhi (a refreshing appetiser prepared with the purple fruit kokam (garcinia) and coconut milk).
 Fulora, Alibaug Rewas Rd, PNP Nagar. The restaurant specialises in seafood although they also provide all kinds of vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. (updated Jun 2018)
